name: Select
description: Dropdown for choosing one or more options.

notes: The trigger is a native button with aria-haspopup="listbox", aria-expanded, and aria-controls pointing at the floating panel.
The floating panel is the single listbox; the inner collection is presentational so options are owned directly by it. Multiple mode adds aria-multiselectable.
Options expose role="option" with aria-selected, and disabled options expose aria-disabled and are skipped by keyboard navigation.
Arrow keys, Home, End, Enter, Space, Tab, and Escape follow the listbox pattern; Escape and selection restore focus to the trigger or its owning list row.
Searchable content announces its empty-results message through a polite live region.
Icon-only triggers need an accessible name through aria-label on Select.Trigger; the chevron sections are hidden from assistive technology.

usage.summary: Compose Select.Trigger with Select.Value, and Select.Content with Select.List containing Select.Item options.

rules.title: Size the root and label the trigger
rules.description: For a full-width field, apply className="w-full self-stretch" to Select, not just its Trigger. Put aria-label or aria-labelledby on Select.Trigger.

contract.nativeProps: HTML div attributes and events go to the root, not the trigger.
contract.state: value/state.value are controlled and accept null for an explicitly empty single selection; selectedKey is the single-selection alternative and also accepts null. Omit controlled selection props for uncontrolled usage; use defaultSelectedKey/defaultSelectedKeys for initial selection. Multiple mode uses arrays. state.open is controlled; onOpenChange reports changes. defaultOpen is initial visibility; open retains legacy initial-only behavior. onSelectionChange reports selection changes.
contract.layout: The trigger fills the root. Set className="w-full self-stretch" on the root for a full-width form field.
contract.composition: Trigger contains Value. Content contains List with Item options; Group can wrap related options. Separator belongs between option groups. Use Group value/onChange for segmented buttons instead of Select.
contract.accessibility: Put aria-label or aria-labelledby on Trigger, not the root. Associate a visible Label with the Trigger id. Put aria-describedby on Trigger.

Trigger.nativeProps: Native button props and events are merged onto the trigger.
Trigger.composition: Use Value as children. An icon-only trigger still needs an accessible name.

Content.nativeProps: HTML div attributes, style, and key events go to the panel, not the positioning overlay.
Content.layout: Anchors to this Select root, including inside Group. Group padding/border affects the offset, not which segment determines the width. position="overlay" aligns the selected option/search surface; top/bottom place a dropdown.

Value.nativeProps: Native div props go to the value wrapper.
Value.composition: placeholder supplies empty text. Render-function children receive the selected registered item or null.

Group.nativeProps: Native div props go to the group wrapper.
Group.composition: Place inside Content/List around related Item options; title renders a visible heading.

examples.name: Labeled controlled field
examples.description: A full-width single select with an explicit empty controlled selection and trigger-level labeling.
